text: Developer: Huaxin Zhang, publishing across platforms as Introvert Arcade. Revised: 2 November 2026.

Map Teleport is a series of world-map teleport mods for Project Zomboid. The current editions are Right-Click Rescue for characters and Vehicle & Trailer for vehicles. They are published and maintained through Steam Workshop.
Development background
Project Zomboid is a demanding game. Players can lose their characters to various hazards, ending a playthrough and detracting from the experience.

Steam Workshop provides a channel for publishing and subscribing to mods. Project Zomboid’s Lua mod system and related development tools allow individual creators to change game rules and controls, then share their work through the Workshop (Steamworks Workshop documentation; official game information). Existing character-teleport tools take different approaches. For example, [B42] Teleportation Menu (simple) lets players enter destination coordinates in a panel, while the update notes for Cheat Menu Phoenix include teleporting characters through the world-map context menu. These mods can move characters to a specified location. However, problems encountered during use included the difficulty of choosing a destination by entering coordinates, conflicts between world-map context-menu options (lower-priority mods or options being obscured, or Teleport Here sometimes missing from the context menu), and large mod files causing the game to lag after loading. These problems led to the development of two world-map teleport mods: Right-Click Rescue and Vehicle & Trailer.
Mod overview
Right-Click Rescue — Character edition

Right-Click Rescue was developed by investigating mod conflicts, adjusting the load order, modifying code and adding an alternative keyboard shortcut. It can be installed directly and supports single-player and multiplayer in B42.21. Players keep the familiar interaction of right-clicking a destination on the world map and selecting Teleport Here. Carried and rope-led animals travel with the character. The teleport option appears alongside other mods’ world-map context-menu options, so players can choose the action they need. An optional keyboard shortcut can be assigned under Options → Key Bindings → Universal Map Teleport, using UMTSP: Teleport Here (World Map). Once assigned, open the world map, point at the destination and press the key to teleport the character.
Vehicle & Trailer — Vehicle edition

Once character teleportation worked, the next question was whether vehicles, trailers and animals could travel too. A player may have spent a long time finding a suitable vehicle. If only the character moves, the vehicles and animals accompanying them remain behind. The player then has to return for the vehicle and trailer or find replacements, while rope-led animals can become separated after the character leaves. This reduces the usefulness of teleportation. No mod offering these functions had been found. Vehicle & Trailer was therefore developed, adding the world-map context-menu option Teleport Vehicle Here. It transfers the current vehicle and its connected towing chain together. Passengers arrive outside the vehicles, which are placed on nearby open ground. Animals loaded through the game’s native in-vehicle animal system or supported mod systems travel too. Towing connections are restored after arrival, as are the leads of rope-led animals travelling with the character. Players can choose whether to teleport characters, vehicles, trailers and animals. The vehicle edition includes the character edition’s functions, but the character edition remains available to accommodate players’ habits and preferences. The vehicle edition also provides an optional shortcut: under Options → Key Bindings → Universal Map Teleport, assign a key to UMTSP: Teleport Here (World Map). Then open the world map, point at the destination and press the key. On foot, this teleports the character directly; while seated in a vehicle, it offers character or vehicle teleportation.
Publication

The Map Teleport series is published on Steam Workshop. The developer uses Introvert Arcade as her publishing name across platforms. An early test mod was made publicly available on the Workshop. Vehicle & Trailer launched on 19 October 2026, followed by Right-Click Rescue the next day. The early test mod was taken down after testing was complete. Each edition has its own logo to help players quickly identify its purpose and controls on the Workshop.

The character edition uses a yellow location marker to represent the destination. A mouse and the Teleport Here menu item illustrate the interaction: right-click the desired location on the map, then choose teleport. Add Destination also appears in the image, expressing the intention that teleportation should coexist with other mods’ map actions. The name Right-Click Rescue reflects the original aim: to give players encountering similar problems a separate menu option for world-map teleportation.

The vehicle edition retains the yellow location marker, map grid and menu styling to give both editions a consistent identity. The car and the animals in the trailer show what can travel, while Teleport Vehicle Here shows how to initiate vehicle teleportation. B42.21 and SINGLE + MULTIPLAYER identify the supported game version and modes.

The two logos use similar visual styling to identify them as part of the same series. Different graphics and menu text distinguish the editions. These visual elements communicate some of the mods’ purposes and functions directly, making them easier for players to identify and use.

Workshop records (Table 1) show a combined total of 612 unique visitors across the series’ pages and close to 400 subscriptions as of 31 October. Right-Click Rescue accounted for 356 unique visitors, 208 subscribers and 18 favourites.

Version maintenance
The vehicle mod was published at 21:19 on 19 October 2026 and had received nine updates at the time of this report;
the character mod was published at 16:47 on 20 October 2026 and had received eight updates.
Maintenance and upgrades will continue.
The developer has revised and tested the mods repeatedly in response to player feedback. Workshop change notes record these adjustments. See:

Project summary

As supporting tools for Project Zomboid, the Map Teleport mods improve compatibility and the experience of character teleportation. The developer’s original vehicle mod prevents players from losing their possessions when teleporting, making the feature more considerate of their needs. Seeing players leave suggestions, express appreciation and share their joy after receiving help has strengthened my confidence in developing new mods.
